It is a caller of emailservice and shippingservice. Its latency-90 rise (z=363, E1) is smaller than emailservice's and matches added downstream wait time. Emailservice's inbound calls (E2) slowed by 55x, which places the delay on the emailservice hop rather than in checkout's own work.
